This page shows the R code and sample results. To regenerate the full dataset, run the following from the repository root with PWT_GA.csv available.

```sh
Rscript scripts/run-data.R pwt data/raw data/temp
```

The last two arguments are the input and output directories. The runner writes the cleaned files to the output directory.

## Download the data

Export the Growth Accounting (GA) table from the [Penn World Table data tool](https://pwt-data-tool.streamlit.app/?page=GA). Select the countries and years you need, then save the CSV as `PWT_GA.csv` in the input directory. The local export used for the example covers 1950–2019 and reports real GDP at constant 2017 national prices.

## Load data

```{r}
library(data.table)

raw_dir <- Sys.getenv("JWE_RAW_DIR", "../data/raw")
output_dir <- Sys.getenv("JWE_OUTPUT_DIR", "../data/temp")
pwt <- file.path(raw_dir, "PWT_GA.csv")

pwtd = fread(pwt, header = T)
setnames(pwtd, gsub(" ", "", colnames(pwtd)))
str(pwtd)
pwtd[, .N, by = .(Variablecode, Variablename)]
```

## Reshape to long format

```{r}
pwtdl = melt(pwtd,
             id.vars = c("Variablecode", "Variablename",
                         "ISOcode", "Country"),
             variable.name = "date",
             variable.factor = FALSE)

setorder(pwtdl, ISOcode, Variablename, date)
```

## Compute year-over-year growth

```{r}
pwtdl[, Lvalue := shift(value, type = "lag"),
      by = .(ISOcode, Variablename)]
pwtdl[, gyoy := value / Lvalue - 1]
pwtdl[, date := as.numeric(date)]

pwtdl[, Variablename2 := trimws(gsub("(\\(|\\,|by\\b|at\\b).*$", "",
                                      Variablename))]
```

Here is an excerpt from Japan's real GDP series. Growth compares each row with the previous year within the same country and series.

| Country | Series | Year | Real GDP (million 2017 US dollars) | Year-over-year growth |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Japan | `rgdpna` | 2018 | 5,065,209 | 0.32% |
| Japan | `rgdpna` | 2019 | 5,099,254 | 0.67% |

## Plot growth rates (Japan vs US)

```{r}
#| purl: false
ggpubr::ggline(pwtdl[ISOcode %in% c("JPN", "USA")
                      & !grepl("Share", Variablename)
                     &!is.na(gyoy)],
               x = "date", y = "gyoy", color = "ISOcode",
               facet.by = "Variablename2",
               numeric.x.axis = T)
```

## Plot index variables

```{r}
#| purl: false
ggpubr::ggline(pwtdl[ISOcode %in% c("JPN", "USA")
                      & grepl("index", Variablename)],
               x = "date", y = "value", color = "ISOcode",
               facet.by = "Variablename2",
               numeric.x.axis = T)
```

## Plot share variables

```{r}
#| purl: false
ggpubr::ggline(pwtdl[ISOcode %in% c("JPN", "USA")
                      & grepl("Share", Variablename)],
               x = "date", y = "value", color = "ISOcode",
               facet.by = "Variablename2",
               numeric.x.axis = T)
```

## Save processed data

```{r}
fwrite(pwtdl[, .(Variablecode,
                  Variablename2,
                  ISOcode, date,
                  value, gyoy)],
       file.path(output_dir, "pwt.csv"))
```
